notes.title: The War Enders: First Strike announced!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

The War Enders: First Strike is on the way, and it’s coming to Steam Early Access first!
We expect to release the Early Access version in Early 2023, and work with all of you on its development. 

The demo version will be available on Oct 1. It contains two stages with four modes. Please feel free to try it out and share your feedback! (Demo version does NOT represent the final quality. )

With the fresh made framework, we are able to achieve new possibilities: 
[list]
    [*]Four game modes with two different score systems and different difficulties.
    [*]A well-adjusted resource system, in which the resource is limited, but fault tolerance is relatively high. 
    [*]We think highly of each player's choice. Thus, we made a customization system, and that customization happens after you choosing from multiple different fighters! 
[/list]

We’re looking forward to sharing The War Enders: First Strike with you all in 2023!

- Crystal Heart's

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1555800/The_War_Enders_First_Strike/

notes.title: Version Update Rev. 2021
notes.content:
Happy Luna New Year!
I am here to present the patch note of version Rev. 2021. 

- Remake some textures. Mainly make the player looks smaller. 
- Fixed the firing angle of Type 3. 
- Remake the Second medium enemy. 
- Remove the second pattern of boss first phase, and correspondingly nerf some health. 
- Remake boss second phase. 
- Remake Type 1. The fire power will change base on player's vertical position. This is now a high risk high pay choice for players. 

Version number changes from 1.54 to Rev. 2021. Soon I will release this version. 
If there are no crucial bugs, then this would be the last update. I made this game when I first learnt how to develop a game, and I did not use a game engine as well. Therefore, the maintainability of the codes was awful. 
There are also many changes I wanted to make, such as the Steam Leaderboard, and more stages. . . but I really could not make them happen. It is a pity, but I tried my best. 

If everything goes well, I think I will be back in 2023. 
See you next battle!

notes.title: Version Update 1.53
notes.content:
- Significantly change the enemies' sniping shots. 
	- Small enemies will shoot correctly when stopping on the top of screen. 
	- Bullet speed difference in different difficulty is reduced, while the base bullet speed is increased. 
	- Ending bonus score will be affected by difficulty factor as well. 
	- Rank will not increase number of bullets any more. 
	- Rank now equals multiplier / 8.0 plus style rank. 
	- The period between each boss pattern has been increased. 
	- We haven't figure out how to change Boss Phase 2, for now we will nerf each pattern of Boss Phase 2 a little bit. 
	- UI changes, difficulty selection is more obvious.

notes.title: Version Update to 1.52
notes.content:
Version HD 1.52: 
	- Fixed logic of enemy destruction. Enemy won't only get destroyed when any player projectiles appear on the screen. 
	- Multiplier will won't drop when you hit any enemy except for the boss. 
	- Small enemies now correctly rotate. 
	- Catching one bullet with Shield will give 0.3 multiplier instead of 0.32 previously.

notes.title: Ofiicial Scoring Guidence
notes.content:
First of all, here are links of scoring run videos.
Hyper Style: https://youtu.be/D-1crklblpM 
Shield Style: https://youtu.be/tdRv5P--CeQ 

In the videos, only the blue fighter is used, but this doesn't mean the blue fighter can achieve the highest possible score. I never calculate which fighter is the best for scoring because I want to leave suspense for players. 
I didn't play so well in the videos as well. I think the potential highest score is higher than 150 mils. 
-
There are three fighters in the game that player can choose from. Base on the order in the selection screen, I call the red one as Type 1, blue one as Type 2, and green one as Type 3. 
Type 1 is made base on Raiden series. It shoots so wide that player doesn't need to worry about swarms. However, it can only concentrate when gets up above on the screen. It is relatively weak when fighting against middle-size enemies and boss. 
Type 2 is an originally made fighter. It always shoots concentratedly and it has the highest speed. The adjustable secondary weapon can be helpful when fighting against swarms. But, this fighter has the lowest damage output in total. 
Type 3 is made base on DDP SDOJ's Type B. Player has to press left and right again and again to fight against swarms. It cannot shoot that concentrate even though it is up above on the screen. It can do everything but not at expertise. 
- 
Style decides how to do scoring. Hyper and Shield match up with two unique scoring method. With Hyper, player can get additional multiplier when enemies are destroyed; with Shield, player can get additional multiplier by colliding with enemies' bullets. 
If player's enemies' destructions is not constant, Multiplier will drop. Thus, control the timing of enemies' destruction is the key of achieving high score. 
Taking hits does not have a connection between player's score on the surface, but when the game ends, an amount of score will be added to player's score. This amount of score varies mostly base on player's left health. It can take upper to 20% of total score.

notes.title: Version Update to v1.51b
notes.content:
Version HD 1.51b:  
	- Buff Hyper duration from 5 secs to 8 secs. 
	- Buff Shield duration from 5 secs to 6 secs. 
	- Nerf passive shield duration from 5 secs to 3 secs. 
	- Buff Boss Phase 1 hp from 8000 to 8400. 
	- Reduce Boss Phase 1 Pattern 3 and 4 duration. 
	- Nerf Boss Phase 2 Pattern 2. 
	- Buff Boss Phase 2 Pattern 3. 
	- Increase end health score. 
	- Background is now more active. 

Version HD 1.51a: 
	- Add the amount of multiplier that player gets from hyper destruction. 
	- Hyper no longer causes double rank. 
	- Style cannot be activated anymore when player has shield. 
	- Style rank will go up by 3 after each style activation now. 
	- Rank now equals multiplier / 5.0 plus style rank. 

Version HD 1.51: 
	- Scoring remake. Activate style doesn't give multiplier anymore. Style rank will go up by 4 instead of 3 after each style activation. 
	- Shield style gain more multiplier when collide enemy bullets with shield. x0.32 for catching each bullet and will hold multiplier from dropping, which is  the quadruple of graze. Shield's diameter has been changed from 64 to 72 pixels. 
	- Hyper style gain more multiplier when kill an enemy. It will triple the multiplier given by enemies' destruction (Killing the boss during hyper will give less). Using hyper still causes a doubled rank. 
	- Graze range has been changed from 64 to 50 pixels. 
	- Buff 5 dps to Type 1's secondary. Debuff 5 dps to Type 2's primary. Current DPS comparasion: Type 1 = 90 55, Type 2 = 75 60, Type 3 = 70 70.
